name: Canopy Forest Villa
tagline: Suspended in the forest canopy, where the rainforest breathes below you.
description: The Canopy Forest Villa offers an extraordinary elevated retreat nestled 12 metres above the forest floor. Floor-to-ceiling glass walls dissolve the boundary between your living space and the ancient tropical forest. Wake to the calls of endemic birds, drift through your private infinity plunge pool, and witness the forest come alive at golden hour from your panoramic timber deck.
amenities: Turn-down service with herbal foot soak
sustainability: Built from reclaimed timber. Solar-heated water. Zero single-use plastics.

name: Lagoon Water Suite
tagline: Float above the lagoon — where sky and water become one.
description: The Lagoon Water Suite sits directly over a natural brackish lagoon. An over-water deck with glass floor panels reveals the life below, while your private pool reflects the ever-changing equatorial sky. The suite's palette — bleached timber, natural linen, mother-of-pearl accents — mirrors the lagoon's own quiet luminosity.
sustainability: Lagoon ecosystem monitoring. Rainwater harvesting for villa use.

name: Treetop Heritage Suite
tagline: A sanctuary of colonial heritage re-imagined for the ultra-luxury traveller.
description: Positioned in the heart of the property's oldest grove, the Treetop Heritage Suite is housed within a restored colonial-era pavilion elevated on ancient ironwood stilts. Antique furnishings sourced from regional estates are paired with contemporary bathrooms of honed limestone and polished concrete. The private deck commands a 270° view across the jungle canopy.
sustainability: Restored heritage structure — zero new-build footprint. Organic linen & cotton.

name: Beachfront Infinity Villa
tagline: Where the Indian Ocean horizon becomes your private view.
description: The Beachfront Infinity Villa offers the resort's most dramatic relationship with the sea. An 18-metre private infinity pool appears to pour directly into the Indian Ocean. The open-plan great room, clad in white-washed coral stone and bleached timber, frames the ocean panorama at every angle. Direct beach access via a private garden path.
sustainability: Coral restoration programme contribution with each stay. Solar energy grid.

name: Garden Pool Villa
tagline: An intimate garden sanctuary — privacy woven in tropical blooms.
description: Enclosed within high garden walls draped in bougainvillea and jasmine, the Garden Pool Villa delivers absolute privacy at ground level. The interior references the brand's A-frame vernacular — raked ceilings, exposed timber rafters, vast glass walls opening to the garden and pool. Ideal for those who treasure seclusion without sacrificing proximity to the resort's facilities.
sustainability: 100% organic garden. Composting programme. Herb garden for in-villa kitchen.

name: Sky Villa Penthouse
tagline: The summit of the Aviora experience — above the canopy, among the clouds.
description: The Sky Villa Penthouse occupies the highest point of the resort's principal structure — a double-height contemporary tower of glass, raw concrete and local stone. From this vantage point, the entire sweep of the jungle, lagoon, and distant ocean is visible. A rooftop plunge pool, a private dining terrace, and a dedicated villa host make this the resort's flagship offering for guests who desire nothing but the exceptional.
sustainability: Net-zero design. All energy from on-site solar. Green roof with native plantings.
